retail_pg:src.customers.description: One row per registered customer. Source of truth for customer attributes and segment.

email.description: Contact email address, unique per customer.

phone.description: Contact phone number; missing for about 10% of customers.

segment.description: Commercial segment: consumer, small_business or enterprise.

retail_pg:src.products.description: Product catalog with list price and unit cost.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit code, unique per product.

category.description: Merchandising category such as Electronics or Apparel.

unit_cost.description: Cost of goods per unit; always below list price.

is_active.description: Whether the product is currently sold.

created_date.description: Date the product was added to the catalog.

retail_pg:src.orders.description: One row per customer order with status, channel and order total.

customer_id.description: Customer who placed the order (references customers).

order_ts.description: Timestamp when the order was placed.

status.description: Order lifecycle status: processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled or returned.

channel.description: Sales channel: web, mobile or store.

total_amount.description: Order total: sum of quantity times unit price over the order's items.

retail_pg:src.order_items.description: Order line items: which products were bought on which order.

unit_price.description: Price per unit at the time of purchase.

web_events_csv:file.web_events.description: Website clickstream events from the CSV export; about a third are anonymous visitors.

session_id.description: Browser session the event belongs to.

customer_id.description: Logged-in customer if known; empty for anonymous visitors.

event_type.description: page_view, product_view, add_to_cart, checkout_start or purchase.

product_id.description: Product involved for product_view and add_to_cart events; otherwise empty.

shipments_parquet:file.shipments.description: Carrier shipment records for shipped, delivered and returned orders.

shipped_at.description: When the carrier received the parcel.

delivered_at.description: When the parcel was delivered; empty while still in transit.

status.description: Shipment status mirrored from the order: shipped, delivered or returned.

gold_pg:gold.daily_sales.description: Daily order totals per sales channel: orders, items, units, gross and net revenue, cancellations, returns and return rate. Source: sales pipeline.

order_date.description: Calendar day the orders were placed.

channel.description: Sales channel: web, mobile or store.

orders.description: Number of orders placed that day in the channel.

gross_merchandise_value.description: Sum of order totals before returns and cancellations.

net_revenue.description: Sum of order totals excluding cancelled and returned orders.

avg_order_value.description: Gross merchandise value divided by orders.

return_rate.description: Returned orders divided by orders (0 to 1).

_run_id.description: Pipeline run that produced this row (lineage).

gold_pg:gold.customer_value.description: One row per customer with order count, net lifetime value, first and last order dates and activity flag. Source: sales pipeline.

segment.description: Commercial segment: consumer, small_business or enterprise.

orders.description: Number of orders placed (0 if none).

lifetime_value.description: Sum of order totals excluding cancelled and returned orders.

last_order_date.description: Date of the most recent order.

avg_order_value.description: Lifetime value divided by orders; empty when there are no orders.

is_active_90d.description: True when the last order is within 90 days of the latest order date in the data.

_run_id.description: Pipeline run that produced this row (lineage).

gold_pg:gold.funnel_daily.description: Daily web funnel per device: sessions, page views, product views, add to cart, checkout starts, purchases and conversion rates. Source: events pipeline.

sessions.description: Distinct sessions with at least one event.

view_to_cart_rate.description: Add to carts divided by product views.

cart_to_purchase_rate.description: Purchases divided by add to carts.

_run_id.description: Pipeline run that produced this row (lineage).

gold_pg:gold.delivery_sla.description: Monthly delivery performance per carrier: shipments, deliveries, lead times and share delivered within the SLA. Source: events pipeline.

ship_month.description: First day of the month the parcels were shipped.

avg_lead_days.description: Average days from shipped to delivered.

on_time_pct.description: Percent of delivered shipments within the SLA days.

_run_id.description: Pipeline run that produced this row (lineage).

glossary.definition: Total value of orders placed before returns and cancellations. In this catalog it is the sum of order total_amount.
Gross merchandise value divided by the number of orders in the same period.
Commercial grouping of a customer: consumer, small business or enterprise.
Stage of an order in its lifecycle: processing, shipped, delivered, cancelled or returned.
Share of orders whose status is returned.
Stock keeping unit: the unique code identifying a sellable product.
Unit price minus unit cost for a product, usually shown as a percentage of price.
A web session with no known customer; customer_id is empty in the clickstream.
A web session that ends in a purchase event, measured against sessions with product views.
Days between a shipment being shipped and delivered.
Total net revenue a customer has generated: order totals excluding cancelled and returned orders.
Share of delivered shipments that arrived within the SLA number of days.
